summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the new Calendar screen and Training-Plan badge system. Backend (8/8 pytest pass, /app/backend/tests/test_calendar.py): GET /api/calendar/week returns the full week doc — 7 days each with cycling/fb50/wellness/readiness, plus 5-zone summary and tip; TUE Threshold Climb has 92 TSS; no ObjectId leak. POST /api/calendar/move moves cycling/fb50/wellness sessions between days, marks status='rescheduled' with scheduled_date set, empties the source slot, and persists (verified by follow-up GET). Invalid session_type is rejected (400/422). Moving from an empty slot returns 400. POST /api/calendar/review returns a real Alberto message (>10 chars, ok=true) — contextually smart: e.g. Threshold→Wed was rejected with a Recovery Ride rationale. POST /api/coach/adaptation returns cached text on repeat calls (cached=true) and regenerates on refresh=true (cached=false). POST /api/coach/debrief succeeds and its background _refresh_adaptation_after_ride updates plan.adaptation_ai_alberto_at within ~15s (polled and verified). Frontend (1440x900 landscape tablet): /calendar renders exactly to reference — ROUJAUNE sidebar with Calendar highlighted, header + subtitle, date controls (12–18 May 2025, Today, Week), 7-day grid with all 5 rows (FOCUS, TRAINING, STRENGTH & MOBILITY, RECOVERY & WELLNESS, DAY READINESS), TUE 13 selected with red readiness ring, right-panel Threshold Climb 1h 00m, 251 W target power, Z4, 92 TSS, power profile bars, View Workout button, Scheduled today. Week Summary shows 5/7 workouts, 6h 24m, 287 TSS, Z1–Z5 bars with times (00:24:15 … 01:06:30). Quick Actions rows all render, Alberto tip footer 'Great week ahead…', SYNC STATUS card 'All synced'. Day selection works: tapping day-head-4 (FRI) swaps right panel to Endurance Ride, tapping readiness-3 (THU) swaps to Sweet Spot. Filters modal opens; selecting 'Cycling' shows an active-filter chip ('Filter: Cycling') with dismiss X. Quick-action qa-recovery fires a toast. Drag-and-drop works on web: long-press + drag on training-c2 (TUE Threshold) → column 2 (WED) opened the Alberto review dialog with loading state, Claude responded with a contextual paragraph ('Moving Threshold Climb to Wednesday would stack hard intensity right on top of your Recovery Ride…'), Confirm/Cancel testIDs present. Plan-badge system: red dot appears next to 'Training Plan' in the sidebar on /calendar; navigating via nav-training to /plan (which triggers markPlanSeen on mount) clears the badge — verified by returning to /calendar (before/after sidebar screenshots show the dot present, then gone). Navigation nav-training→/plan and nav-calendar→/calendar works cleanly; view-workout in the right panel jumps to /workout. Deprecated packages detected: none. No red-screen errors, no console errors. Console warnings: textShadow* style prop deprecated (pre-existing, non-blocking) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (pre-existing from an underlying component).

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing web-only warning: '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow".' Not from calendar.tsx directly; from theme text-shadow helper. Non-blocking.
Web console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking, appears on /calendar mount.

action_items: Optional: migrate remaining textShadow* / pointerEvents call sites to their unified style props to silence RN-Web warnings.

Optional (edge case): if data resilience matters, /api/calendar/move currently allows moving into a day that already has that session-type (destination is overwritten). Consider surfacing a 'session already scheduled' confirmation or merging instead of overwriting.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: calendar endpoints correctly pop _id before returning, seed on first read, and persist via update_one upsert.
server.py: /api/calendar/move validates session_type ∈ {cycling,fb50,wellness} and 400s when the source slot is empty.
server.py: /api/calendar/review gracefully falls back to a canned message if the LLM call fails and never leaks a stack (ok=true either way).
server.py: _refresh_adaptation_after_ride is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task and never blocks the debrief response — verified end-to-end via the badge test.
frontend/src/lib/plan-badge.ts: badge state is a module-level flag + listener set; correctly re-emits on markPlanSeen and refreshPlanBadge changes. AsyncStorage compares ISO timestamps.

frontend/app/calendar.tsx: DraggableSession + resolveTarget correctly translates dx into a target column index; drop opens the review modal in loading state and only performs the move on Confirm — verified in the browser.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all reviewed features working: rendering, day selection, filters, quick actions, drag-and-drop → review → confirm, plan badge appear/clear, sidebar nav)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests and one manual drag-and-drop mutated db.calendar_weeks then were reset by deleting the doc so the next GET re-seeded CALENDAR_WEEK verbatim (verified: TUE Threshold Climb, WED Recovery Ride, SUN Rest Day all restored). db.training_plans.adaptation_ai_alberto and adaptation_ai_alberto_at were regenerated by the debrief background task — this is expected and is what the badge test is exercising; safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Viewport used: 1440x900 (landscape tablet). Public backend URL: https://coach-alberto-dash.preview.emergentagent.com. Key testIDs verified live: day-head-0..6, readiness-0..6, training-c1..c7, fb50-f1..f7, wellness-r1..r7, filters-btn, filter-{All,Cycling,FB50,Recovery,My Peaceful Companion,Completed,Planned,Alberto-generated}, qa-reschedule/qa-add/qa-recovery/qa-fb50, view-workout, review-confirm, review-cancel, undo-move, active-filter, nav-home/nav-training/nav-calendar/nav-workouts. Drag-and-drop DID work on the web preview: mouse.down() then wait 350ms then move in ~20 small horizontal steps then mouse.up(). NOTE: review-confirm is `disabled={review?.loading}` — if you click before the Claude response arrives (~5–10s), the click is a no-op. Poll for the actual message body to appear (locator with review dialog text change, not the header) before clicking Confirm. If tests move sessions, reset by deleting the mongo doc: `await db.calendar_weeks.delete_many({'start_date':'2025-05-12'})` — next GET reseeds. Do NOT rely on the seed persisting across test runs. Plan badge test: to force the dot back, POST to /api/coach/debrief once (this bumps plan.adaptation_ai_alberto_at) then reload /calendar in a browser that has NO AsyncStorage entry for roujaune:planAdaptationSeenAt (fresh session/incognito).
rca_of_issue: N/A — all features working. Two pre-existing non-blocking web console warnings (textShadow*, pointerEvents) originate from the shared theme/pressable layer, not from calendar-specific code.
